costGuide.title: Toyota A25A-FXS Engine Replacement Cost (UK)
costGuide.labourLine: Fitting an A25A-FXS typically takes 10-14 hours at £65-£85/hr (independent) - confirm exact labour when comparing quotes. Hybrid systems require additional high-voltage isolation and complex cooling system bleeding, which can extend labour times .

failures.title: Toyota A25A-FXS Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Head Gasket Failure & Coolant Consumption - 2018-2019 models
items.whatHappens: Early production A25A-FXS units are prone to head gasket degradation, manifesting as unexplained coolant loss, white exhaust smoke, or coolant entering the cylinders. If ignored, overheating can warp the aluminium cylinder head or cause hydro-lock.
items.repairVsReplace: A standalone head gasket replacement is possible if caught early and the block is undamaged, but if the engine has overheated significantly, a full A25A-FXS engine replacement is the only reliable long-term solution to prevent repeat failure.

items.title: Water Pump & Cooling System Leaks
items.whatHappens: The complex cooling system required for both the engine and the hybrid inverter relies on multiple electric water pumps. Failure of the engine-side water pump leads to rapid overheating, while inverter pump failure triggers hybrid system warning lights and reduced power mode.
items.repairVsReplace: Water pump replacement is a routine maintenance fix. However, if the engine has been run hot due to a failed pump, cylinder head warping is highly likely, necessitating a full A25A-FXS replacement.

failures.goodYearsLine: Post-2020 revisions of the A25A-FXS received updated head gasket specifications and revised cooling system components, significantly reducing the early coolant consumption issues seen in the 2018-2019 launch models .
failures.cta: → Compare rebuilt A25A-FXS prices with the failure already addressed

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the A25A-FXS
variants.intro: The A25A-FXS engine code is stamped directly onto the engine block, typically located on a machined pad near the junction of the engine block and the hybrid transaxle. It is also clearly listed on your vehicle's V5C registration document under "Engine Number" and can be definitively verified via a VIN decode. Owners frequently confuse the A25A-FXS with the older 2AR-FXE (the previous generation 2.5L hybrid) or the non-hybrid A25A-FKS (the 2.5L Dynamic Force petrol). Fitting a non-hybrid A25A-FKS into a hybrid host will result in severe ECU and hybrid system mismatch errors, while swapping an older 2AR-FXE will not mate correctly with the TNGA hybrid transaxle. Always verify the exact code before purchasing a replacement.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement A25A-FXS - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used A25A-FXS can be a viable option for higher-value TNGA hosts, provided the seller can supply documented evidence that the early head gasket recall/TSB has been performed. The primary risk is inheriting hidden coolant contamination or hybrid system faults.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: A proper reconditioned A25A-FXS is the most recommended path for most owners. A reputable supplier will have replaced the head gasket with the updated specification, pressure-tested the block and head, and renewed the water pumps, directly addressing the engine's known failure points.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified if the original A25A-FXS suffered catastrophic overheating with cylinder scoring, requiring a full strip, new pistons, and a machined or replacement cylinder head to restore factory tolerances.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: For complete peace of mind, our network offers full supply and fit packages, ensuring the replacement A25A-FXS is installed by a vetted specialist and backed by a nationwide warranty.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: Typical host vehicles like the Toyota RAV4 XA50 and Camry XV70 currently hold values between £15,000 and £30,000. Because these are high-value, modern hybrid vehicles, a reconditioned A25A-FXS replacement is financially viable and well within the vehicle's market value, making replacement the clear choice over scrapping.

items.answer: A reconditioned Toyota A25A-FXS engine costs between £3,000 and £4,500 for supply-only, with fully fitted prices ranging from £3,650 to £5,150. Labour typically adds 10-14 hours due to hybrid system isolation requirements, while used units are available from £1,500 but carry a higher risk of inherited early-production head gasket issues. → Compare A25A-FXS engine prices from vetted UK suppliers

items.question: What is the most common failure with the A25A-FXS engine?
items.answer: The most documented issue with the A25A-FXS is head gasket degradation and subsequent coolant loss, primarily affecting 2018-2019 models. Overheating can warp the aluminium cylinder head or cause catastrophic hydro-lock if ignored, while concurrent water pump or electric inverter pump failures can accelerate this thermal stress. → Compare rebuilt A25A-FXS prices with the failure already addressed

items.question: Which Toyota models use the A25A-FXS engine?
items.answer: The A25A-FXS was primarily fitted to the Toyota RAV4 (XA50) and Toyota Camry (XV70) from 2018 onwards. It serves as the petrol component of the TNGA hybrid electric powertrain, and owners should always verify their specific chassis code, as non-hybrid variants use the A25A-FKS code. → Confirm your exact A25A-FXS fitment with a free registration check

items.question: Should I buy a used or reconditioned A25A-FXS engine?
items.answer: A reconditioned A25A-FXS is strongly recommended over a used unit due to the engine's susceptibility to early head gasket degradation. A proper rebuild will replace the head gasket with the updated specification and pressure-test the block and head, whereas used units often retain the underlying thermal stress or warped heads that caused the original failure. → View our guide to reconditioned vs used A25A-FXS engines

items.question: How do I know if my car has the A25A-FXS engine?
items.answer: You can confirm your vehicle has the A25A-FXS engine by checking the V5C registration document under 'Engine Number' or locating the code stamped on the engine block near the hybrid transaxle. It is frequently confused with the non-hybrid A25A-FKS or the older 2AR-FXE, and fitting the wrong revision will result in severe ECU and hybrid system mismatch errors. → Enter your registration above for an instant A25A-FXS fitment check

items.question: What is the expected longevity of the A25A-FXS engine?
items.answer: With the updated head gasket specification applied to post-2020 models, the A25A-FXS is designed to routinely exceed 150,000 miles with standard maintenance. Strict adherence to Toyota's hybrid battery cooling and engine oil change intervals is critical, and early signs of coolant consumption should be investigated immediately to prevent catastrophic failure. → Compare rebuilt A25A-FXS prices for long-term peace of mind
